_doc: Fishing at the pier and the photo mode (village chapters). Fishing: E at the spot casts; after a random wait the fish bites and the player has bite_window seconds to strike (E, Space, click or A); a strike gives one fish of a species drawn by weight, which goes to the stock as 'peixe' (Seu Severino's chapter asks for 4). Photo mode: P takes a picture (saved in Saved/Album); every subject inside the frame, closer than its max distance and not hidden behind a wall, is recorded in the album (prog.album) and flags its chapter step (prog.chp). A subject with sun = true is the sun itself: low (elevation under max_elevation degrees), within angle degrees of the view, at the given hours (the sunset). World cm. 11/11 (Fase 3) bait, fight and the species book: 'baits' (massa is free and endless; the others are bought in packs at the pier, prog.bait); each species has 'strength' (0..1, how hard it pulls in the fight; bigger fish of the species pull harder), 'bait' (weight multiplier per bait id, 1 when absent), optional 'hours' [from, to] of the day it bites, and a 'hint' shown in the book before the first catch. After the strike the fish is fought: holding reels the line in and raises the tension, a pulling fish raises it faster; the line snaps over the limit, a slack line lets the fish go (FMareFishFight, MareFishing.h). First catch of a species: 'first_fame'; the whole book: 'book_reward' R$. photo_challenges: one-time goals of the photo mode, done when one photo holds 'all' the subjects (or 'count' different ones); reward in R$ and fame.
